evidence.text: FNBO’s Marc Butterfield says banks must feed AI models better data and identify shopping agents to protect customers as LLMs drive card searches.
FNBO, a Midwest super regional with about $35 billion in assets, is working on that responsibility across data, fraud, product design, and its own roadmap.
The payment rails for agentic transactions largely already exist; the open question is identification.
“Do we know if it’s an agent or not? Well, in some cases, we don’t,” Butterfield said.
